visual_review: Before merged a small faceless head into a vase-shaped body with a hook for the paw (read as a pot). Redrawn from the reference: larger eared head with two eyes, chin line doubling as the collar with the bell medallion hanging from it, round body, raised beckoning paw rising from the left shoulder. Valid, gate pass.
omissions: Closed-eye arcs drawn as dots (arcs this short render as blobs at 48); tail and outlined paw (no 8-wide room beside the head).
